latest.text: Added filament printers. A plastic 3D printer takes a floor bay and prints letters, numbers and emoji in white, black, red, blue or yellow filament, the color of whatever spool it has loaded. Owning one brings in orders in filament colors that only a printer can make. Thin parts like a 1 print fast and a fat 8 or an emoji takes longer, a printer works the colors already on its spool first, a different color means an operator swaps the spool, and now and then a print turns to spaghetti and gets scraped off the bed. Tapping a printer opens a keypad that prints any part ahead into the bins in the picked spool color, and orders take from the bins first.

groundcore.summary: Desert planting planner with row spacing, plant lookup, and a map sandbox for laying out rows.
groundcore.name: GroundCore

latest.text: Fixed the build so a push to main deploys the app from its deploy folder.

fogwarren-vx.summary: A retro desktop fog of war maze game with mines and a hidden picture
fogwarren-vx.name: FogWarren

latest.text: Version two sends your score, initials, and a site link to the shared score hub. Added a High Scores board.

rosetta-pone.summary: A cuneiform to English translator with a sign keyboard
rosetta-pone.name: Rosetta Pone

latest.text: Every key on the sign keyboard now shows its English meaning.

tickle-boxie.summary: A talk box voice effect studio with mic and speaker choice
tickle-boxie.name: Talk Box Studio

latest.text: Created the talk box app. Added separate mic and speaker choice and a feedback guard.

chromahum-zq.summary: A camera color to sound instrument with tiles, patterns, and an infinite canvas
chromahum-zq.name: ChromaHum Tiles

latest.text: Added patterns and tiles as sources, plus a My Tile editor. Added zoom, pan, and colors, and removed the chime. Added a movement engine and an infinite canvas. Added voice draw, a cleaner audio chain that avoids pops, and pattern backdrops.

mohave-wtf.summary: A retro styled catalog page for the developer's apps
mohave-wtf.name: Retro Software Catalog

latest.text: Removed Tunnel FX from the catalog. Labeled CoffeeKit One as a game and Coffee Autosim as a simulator.

tapperator.summary: A steering wheel drum kit with a looper and band room sync
tapperator.name: Tapperator

latest.text: Created the app as a steering wheel drum kit with a five round calibration, a four tab looper, and room sync. Added sampling for each instrument with five sets per pad. Players now start with two pads and add more later, with striker tips and mix-up warnings.

inkrunner.summary: A comic ink driving sim with tricks, laps, and free driving
inkrunner.name: Inkrunner

latest.text: Created the game as a comic ink driving sim. Added air tricks, a track loop with barricades, a crash reset, and a lap ghost. Added outer walls, a wider road, zoom out, and a brace button. Fixed a crash at the wall band and opened free driving outside the walls.

field-twin-violet-api.summary: A phone inventory app for parts, vendors, orders, and locations
field-twin-violet-api.name: Field Twin Violet

latest.text: Added one look across the Field Twin apps, so the map, inventory, and roads share a design. Added a night look that follows sunset and sunrise, and a drawn sign for every kind of place.

five-minute-momentum-engine.summary: A Python engine that runs a fixed five minute momentum strategy in simulation
five-minute-momentum-engine.name: Five Minute Momentum Engine

latest.text: Added a live data adapter, a configuration for a stock index fund, and a live runner. The live runner does not log in to a broker.

hoofer-sync.summary: A dance floor where every phone in the band room gets a dancer
hoofer-sync.name: Hoofer Sync

latest.text: Added a dance floor with a dancer for every phone in the room. A phone now dances as soon as it joins. Loop parts only go to phones that are playing. Added tabs for Floor, Moves, Wardrobe, and Studio, a move maker, outfits, famous routines, and up to fifteen dancers.

field-twin-viridian.summary: A field twin app that reads and tracks license plates
field-twin-viridian.name: Field Twin Viridian

latest.text: First version. Added a plate reader status and reading while parked, with an upload status. Then added plate sightings, a best photo, a pass on state and color, and a page for each plate.

2026-10-18-orange-testbed.summary: A shared city where AI agents take turns building, with a viewer and a web API.
2026-10-18-orange-testbed.name: Agent Test Bed

latest.text: The agent turn for the day was played and merged into the city.

steward-repo.summary: Two AI agents that keep the shared city's water, sewer, and street life running
steward-repo.name: Steward Repo

latest.text: The Commissioner of Public Works now plays at most once a day. The fallback detailer also plays at most once a day. Paper boys now run only when switched on instead of by the clock.

stackloom-meta.summary: A studio game with orders, terminals, agents, developers, and offices
stackloom-meta.name: Stackloom

latest.text: Added version 2. It brings a Doku product line and a Hackerdoku campaign with a botnet, tools, and ranks.

fatty-fart-pedal.summary: A silly stomp pedal instrument that plays fart sounds, alone or in a room
fatty-fart-pedal.name: Fatty Fart Pedal

latest.text: Created the pedal as a room instrument. Stomp to play a sound, build a one bar pattern, and join a room by code. Removed two ding recordings so only the fart sounds remain.

2026-10-20-orange-dialbeat.summary: A drum machine with dial rows, instrument families, presets, and toy sounds
2026-10-20-orange-dialbeat.name: Dial Queue

latest.text: Added stomp box rooms. Players in a room share one clock and one tempo, and a roster shows who has joined.

itchy-troll.summary: An agent that ships one app a day to a game publishing site and keeps a ledger
itchy-troll.name: Itchy Troll

latest.text: Added a browser userscript that fills in a game's page on the publishing site from a saved page file, including description, tagline, genre, and tags. It picks the genre from the site's own dropdown, treats a genre that is already set as done, uploads cover and gameplay screenshots, and can create new pages. Added EDMIA cover and gameplay screenshots and queued Gladhand Dockyard next. Page text is now pasted by hand, so the page workflow was removed.

text-based-game.summary: A tabletop text game with miniatures where an AI crew takes your orders
text-based-game.name: Text Based Game

latest.text: Created the game with a page and an AI turn function. AI turns now go through the shared server and the AI status messages are gone. Added a tabletop board with miniatures and guide suggestions, and removed the mic.

shared-server.summary: One server that holds a single Claude key for every app
shared-server.name: Shared Server

latest.text: Added the roast, push, and fleet apps for HeckleTroll.

forkmill-zx.summary: A voice text adventure mill that uses an AI engine
forkmill-zx.name: Forkmill

latest.text: Created the game. It is a voice text adventure mill with an AI engine.

2026-10-22-orange-agent.summary: An AI agent that builds the north and east side of a shared line drawn city
2026-10-22-orange-agent.name: Agent Orange

latest.text: Added a chapel and worker housing turn. The playbook now covers reading the board. Fixed a street edge in both kits.

purple-agent.summary: An AI agent that builds one block of a shared city in the Agent Test Bed
purple-agent.name: Purple Agent

latest.text: Created the runner for the Purple agent with a daily schedule. Added streaming model calls, retries, and a public run log. Added quality checks for building fronts, street format, and walkers, plus owner feedback. The agent now retries the test bed instead of failing, saves its last checked plan if the model stops answering, and runs five times a day. Added local dry runs and a shared notes board.

purple-vault.summary: A private store that holds one saved setting for the Purple agent
purple-vault.name: Purple Vault

latest.text: Created the private store with the first saved value for the Purple agent.

testbed-notes.summary: A shared notes board where agents playing the test bed leave messages for each other.
testbed-notes.name: Test Bed Notes

latest.text: The olive agent added its first note.

blue-agent.summary: The runner and dashboard that schedule AI agents to play the test bed.
blue-agent.name: Blue Agent

latest.text: The detailer now plays once a day at a set time and retries hourly when out of credit. The deploy script fixes the phone DNS for the backend service.

blue-agent-sandbox.summary: A sandbox copy of the agent test bed where AI agents build a shared city
blue-agent-sandbox.name: Agent Test Bed Sandbox

latest.text: Created the sandbox as a copy of the agent test bed. Synced it with the secured version of the test bed.

2026-10-23-orange-smash.summary: A song mashup tool that matches vocals to beats by tempo and drops them on the bar.
2026-10-23-orange-smash.name: Smash Director

latest.text: Added Send to Smash Bender, which posts the instrumental and acapella to the processing server from Smash and from saved samples. Sends go through the phone relay, and songs are named by artist and song. Both clips now start lined up at the drop or the sample. The samples list shows song names on their own line with the buttons wrapped below.

sound-bender.summary: A page that bends the pitch and tempo of a sound through a processing server
sound-bender.name: Sound Bender

latest.text: First release. Added Sound Bender version 1, a bend page and a Rubber Band processing server.

welcome-to-the-madness.summary: A kitchen rush game where you pull orders before they burn
welcome-to-the-madness.name: Welcome to the Madness

latest.text: First release. Added the kitchen rush game, then leveled it up with canvas graphics, a doneness ring, perfect pulls, combos, rush levels, sound, and a pause button.

charley-douglass.summary: A phone laugh track box with keys, a looping crowd pattern, and shared rooms.
charley-douglass.name: Laugh Box

latest.text: First release. A laugh box with playable keys, held laughs, a one bar pattern, a room loop, and the option to load your own recording on a key.

bpm-finder.summary: Hold a phone near a speaker and read the tempo of the music in beats per minute.
bpm-finder.name: BPM Finder

latest.text: First release. A tempo finder that listens through the microphone, shows beats per minute on a dial with a confidence meter, and has a tap button.

qsr-timeline-Orange.summary: A timeline of quick service restaurant menus through the decades, with early menus and photos.
qsr-timeline-Orange.name: QSR Timeline

latest.text: First release. Added the QSR Timeline page, then added menus from before quick service, 1880 to 1920, with photos. The photos are served from GitHub so the site upload stays small.

conveyor-sim.summary: A conveyor simulation started from a copy of the agent test bed.
conveyor-sim.name: Conveyor Sim

latest.text: First release. Started the conveyor simulation as a copy of the agent test bed.

pdf-yourself.summary: Open a PDF, tap a line of text, and change what it says without leaving your device.
pdf-yourself.name: PDF Text Editor

latest.text: First release. A PDF text editor that highlights editable lines, replaces text in a matching font, tracks edits, and downloads the result. A deploy was triggered later the same day.

smash-bender.summary: A server that sings one song's words on another song's timing and notes.
smash-bender.name: Smash Bender

latest.text: Added a chop tool that cuts a slice from a sample, reads its notes, and writes Strudel code with a link to open it. Chop timing is exact, the notes are cleaner, and the original slice plays in sync under the notes. The sample log can chop any sample into notes, save a slice to GitHub, and add a sound clip. A publish endpoint sends clips to the Strudel sample repo.

mission-operator-next.summary: Field scanner console for nearby aircraft, radios, mesh nodes, and towers, rebuilt with honest error states.
mission-operator-next.name: Mission Operator Next

latest.text: Every relay call now has a timeout, so a slow feed fails fast, and relays answer in one shape with a hint instead of a bare error. Feeds that need a server key say so plainly, and the app stops asking for a feed it knows it cannot get. API keys are now read from a key store instead of environment variables. Added labels for screen readers and handoff notes for the project.

2026-10-30-orange-scores.summary: Shared score board and live plays feed that the games send their scores to.
2026-10-30-orange-scores.name: Score Hub

latest.text: Registered FogWarren on the score hub so its scores show up there.

a-canticle-for-pajamastan.summary: A top down action role playing game set in Pajamastan with a playable slice and a relay
a-canticle-for-pajamastan.name: A Canticle for Pajamastan

latest.text: Created the game. It is a top down action role playing game set in Pajamastan, with spells, status effects, traps, a bestiary, gear, loot, a town, a character maker, a quest board, cutscenes, weather, a radar, and a playable slice. A relay screen lets players chat and connect to a shared relay. Early fights were eased, enemies stay inside their rooms, and labels on the town and switch yard were made larger.

algorithm-albatross.summary: Instrumental skeleton analysis and cover pair matching for songs
algorithm-albatross.name: Algorithm Albatross

latest.text: Added a bass line layer. It reads an eighth note bass pitch for each bar and compares it between songs, allowing for transposition and tempo changes.

tomatomo.summary: A pocket pet handheld game you raise from an egg
tomatomo.name: Tomatomo

latest.text: Created the app. It is a pocket pet handheld game where you hatch an egg, feed your pet, play with it, clean up after it, and put it to sleep. The pet grows and can evolve. You can rename it or start over with a new egg.

j30p4rdy.summary: A Jeopardy style lyrics quiz where players race to buzz in on song clues.
j30p4rdy.name: J30P4RDY

latest.text: First release. This is version 2 of a Jeopardy style lyrics quiz. Players race to buzz in, with rebounds, Double and Final rounds, shot clocks, and a bigger bank of clues.

infinicanvan.summary: An infinite zooming canvas with drawing tools and growing trees.
infinicanvan.name: Infinicanvan

latest.text: First release. An infinite canvas that zooms without limit, with a pen, emoji stamps, paint mode, and cat tools. This version adds tap to water, puddles, a sky, a bark trunk, grass, and resource gauges for growing trees.

2026-11-01-orange-decimalday.summary: A decimal day clock with a day count since 1970 and a normal clock with time zones.
2026-11-01-orange-decimalday.name: Decimal Day Clock

latest.text: First release. It shows the day on a decimal clock, with a count of days since 1970 and a normal clock with a time zone search. Days are grouped into weeks of 100 days, and each day cell shows its old calendar date. A notepad counts days up from 1970.

67-idea-generator.summary: A sixty second pitch timer that records takes, reads them back in a chosen voice, and exports the good ones
67-idea-generator.name: 67 Idea Generator

latest.text: Created the app. It gives you sixty seconds to tell someone about something you made, in a product spot, radio ad, how it got built, or deadpan infomercial style, with a color wipe that counts the time and marks for problem, solution, and features. Takes are saved, can be marked good, and can be read back in a chosen voice. You can sign in, keep takes in projects, and export good takes or all of them. Your own voice service key is kept on your device in Settings.

2026-11-04-field-dispatch.summary: A field service dispatch game where crews drive real roads to repair cameras and fill tickets
2026-11-04-field-dispatch.name: Field Dispatch

latest.text: Created Field Dispatch, a field service dispatch game on a real map of Nevada. Crews take tickets from an open board and follow real road routes between start and end points. Added real cameras to repair, satellite passes, plate reader service contracts at known locations that you can decline, and stashed wireless site scans with a daily cap. A movement badge uses motion sensing and a rule that you must drive 25 mph for 2 minutes. Added Tickets, Crew, Stock, Cameras, and Shop tabs and a restart option. The game code was split into smaller parts without changing how it plays.

2026-11-04-orange-hush.summary: An Android notification blocker that holds alerts and releases them together on a schedule
2026-11-04-orange-hush.name: Hush

latest.text: Created Hush, an Android app that blocks notifications. Added a digest that holds blocked notifications and releases them together on a preset schedule, from every hour to once a day at 8 AM. The app is built into an installable APK automatically on every push.

2026-11-05-drive-thru-dental.summary: A drive-thru dental simulator game played in the browser
2026-11-05-drive-thru-dental.name: Drive-Thru Dental Simulator

latest.text: Created the Drive-Thru Dental Simulator, a game where you run a dental window like a drive-thru. Patients arrive at the window, you can ask them to say it again, clear the tray, and hand out the order at the window.

2026-11-05-locker-screen.summary: A parcel locker kiosk screen with code entry, languages, and repair flows
2026-11-05-locker-screen.name: Locker Screen

latest.text: Created Locker Screen, a parcel locker kiosk with an attract screen. Added scan and code entry screens, a tracking number keyboard, language and help screens, and a high contrast option. Added technician troubleshooting screens, a hardware keypad, sensor and door repair flows, and tests for every part.

coffeekit1.summary: A coffee shop training game with kitchen display orders and cleaning rounds
coffeekit1.name: CoffeeKit One

latest.text: Added CoffeeKit One as a copy of the live app. Version 2 makes light mode the default and adds a night shift option, a menu in the upper left, saved records, and a new shift button. The layout is steadier and sized for phones.

hire-portal.summary: A practice job application portal that teaches what to share at each step
hire-portal.name: Hire Portal

latest.text: Added a headshot upload for the badge, saved with the profile. Added a company template with a complete profile view that can be downloaded.

rainbow-run.summary: A wall of phones that shows synced visualizer scenes for the stompbox API
rainbow-run.name: Rainbow Run

latest.text: Added a play a song feature. The song and its chiptune now drive the Spectral Engine and Screensaver scenes the way the microphone does.

downfree-foundry.name: Road Layers
downfree-foundry.summary: A browser tool that stacks cars from several drive clips onto one road

latest.text: Added a Music tab to Road Layers. It finds kick, snare, and hi-hat hits in a song, and cutouts pop in on the hits with the song playing in the composite and in recordings. Play and pause are more reliable, dragging to pan no longer pulls you back, and each kind of cutout gets a color coded drum.

pajamastan-badge-tool.summary: A badge designer with templates, people, and a paper mockup reader
pajamastan-badge-tool.name: Badge Tool

latest.text: Added a back side builder for badges with an NFC spot, a QR code, text boxes, seals, and a security look.

stinkin-badges.summary: The backend that reads badge mockups and saves badge data
stinkin-badges.name: Stinkin Badges

latest.text: Created the backend for the badge tool. It reads paper mockups with an AI model and saves to a shared cloud database. Sign in uses email links, and the badge tool is allowed as a return address.

flipcount-game.name: FLIPCOUNT
flipcount-game.summary: Eight counting toys including a flip dot display, an abacus, and number scripts

latest.text: Created FLIPCOUNT with seven tabs for counting and number toys. Added a languages tab with spoken words, ancient numerals, and world digit scripts.

pajamastan-space-administration.name: Pajamastan Space Administration
pajamastan-space-administration.summary: A space weather globe with a solar burst simulator and live satellite positions

latest.text: Created the page with a globe showing live solar activity, the magnetosphere, the poles, and satellite risk. Added a solar burst simulator and live satellite positions with hazard coloring and a backup orbit feed.

2026-11-09-orange-icefiles.summary: A novelty agent ID card maker with a photo and a front and back export.
2026-11-09-orange-icefiles.name: Ice Files

latest.text: Created Ice Files, a novelty member ID maker for field agents of a frozen drink company. You fill in your details and add a photo, and it builds a card with a front and a back. Added a his or her choice, a license back for each persona, and a fix for phone screens that clipped the card.

lv-liquor-map.summary: A map of Las Vegas liquor stores, casino bars, and bars with filters.
lv-liquor-map.name: LV Liquor Intel

latest.text: Version four now ships with store data baked in from an open places dataset. Added a grocery layer and merged in street map data.

particular-lenticular.summary: A phone toy that blends three photos into a tilting lenticular picture.
particular-lenticular.name: Lenticular Tilt

latest.text: Created Lenticular Tilt, a phone toy that turns three photos into a tilting lenticular picture.

scorpion-supper.summary: An endless arcade game where a scorpion eats to grow and hides from coyotes.
scorpion-supper.name: Scorpion Supper

latest.text: Added Scorpion Supper version seven, an endless growth eater with coyotes and coops. You steer a scorpion on an open range and eat to grow, and the world scales up as you do.

strudel-samples.summary: A pack of short sound clips that Strudel can load by name.
strudel-samples.name: Strudel Samples

latest.text: Added a word puller that grabs every short clip of one word. The first pull was the word hello, trimmed tight with misses dropped and a hello supercut added. Every sample is now named by its words, show, episode, and clip id, and a catalog lists them all.

city-seek.summary: A zoomable generated city where you hunt for hidden items.
city-seek.name: City Seek

latest.text: Created City Seek, a huge zoomable city that is built fresh each time, with hidden items to find. Version three added a city builder with see through interiors, sandboxes, and towers, plus a tower floor view and an x-ray zoom. Ten of every hidden item are spread across the city, and tray cards count the copies you have found. Added swinging outside doors, flying birds, a Bluebird hunt, tap reactions, word bubbles, and synth sound effects with a sound toggle. Added office props, sports fields, basketball courts, traffic cones, and eighteen new hidden items.

skyflow-orange.summary: A tower crane game where you stack crates before time runs out.
skyflow-orange.name: Sky Flow

latest.text: Created Sky Flow, a crane game where you stack crates as high as they will stand before the clock runs out. Added timed rounds, scoring, sound, and a leaderboard.

spyhunt.summary: A phone map game where red and blue spies hunt each other.
spyhunt.name: Spy Hunt

latest.text: Created Spy Hunt, a phone map game where players join a game by code as a red spy or a blue spy. The map shows the other players in the same game. You can set the cycle length, the number of spies, and your slot number.

spyhunt-server.summary: The server that shares player positions for Spy Hunt.
spyhunt-server.name: Spy Hunt Server

latest.text: Created the Spy Hunt server, which keeps track of where each player in a game is. Each phone sends its position and gets back the other players it has seen recently. Players who go quiet for a minute are dropped.
